## Start with the accounting records.

The process of documenting company losses should begin with a thorough review of the company's accounting records. This includes an examination of the general ledger, journal entries, and supporting documentation such as invoices, contracts, and appraisals. This initial review will help to identify potential losses and gather the information necessary to accurately assess and document them.
